# Realms of Power Magic Sample

Creatures of the Magic Realm.

## Magic Creatures

### Elemental of Flame

Magic Might: 20 (Ignem)

Size: -1

A spirit of pure fire that bargains poorly with travelers who carry water.

### Shade of the Old Oak

Local shepherds tell of a guardian that watches the grove at dusk and turns
trespassers aside with whispered threats rather than open force. Travelers who
camp beneath the canopy sometimes wake to find their gear rearranged and their
fires smothered, as if the wood itself rejected their stay.

Magic Might: 15 (Herbam)

Size: 3
Season: Summer

A slow spirit bound to an ancient oak.
